Underlying_Risk: Labels may be opaque or source-dependent.
Original_Praxis_Problem: The prior Praxis did not sufficiently trace how Cloudflare events entered the corpus.
Remediation_Action: Completed label provenance and Cloudflare label-entry trace.
Key_Result: Endpoints, fields, event identifiers, and local conversion paths documented.
Limitation: Outage labels remain Cloudflare outage annotations; not all are globally independent BGP root-cause labels.
Defense_Talking_Point: Cloudflare is the corpus source; independent validation is limited and separately documented.

Underlying_Risk: Features could overlap conceptually with source detection evidence.
Original_Praxis_Problem: The manuscript risked treating all label evidence as independent from routing features.
Remediation_Action: Classified overlap into predictive association, partial evidence overlap, circular risk, target leakage, or review.
Key_Result: Conceptual overlap documented separately from direct target leakage.
Limitation: Underlying evidence-source independence is limited for routing-derived incident sources.
Defense_Talking_Point: Conceptual overlap is not the same as leakage; direct target leakage was separately checked.

Underlying_Risk: Model features might encode incident class directly.
Original_Praxis_Problem: Prior narrative needed a direct leakage check.
Remediation_Action: Audited all 74 features for class/source-label encodings.
Key_Result: No direct class, source event type, label text, or label-derived numeric encoding found among model features.
Limitation: Audit is based on preserved schema and artifacts.
Defense_Talking_Point: No direct target field is present in V4.

Underlying_Risk: Balanced classes may not represent source prevalence.
Original_Praxis_Problem: The original manuscript needed clearer separation between controlled balanced evaluation and observed source distribution.
Remediation_Action: Completed corpus balancing audit and natural-prior sensitivity.
Key_Result: Final corpus verified at 473/473/473; source raw counts were much larger for Hijack/Leak than Outage.
Limitation: Balanced corpus is a controlled scientific design, not a prevalence estimate.
Defense_Talking_Point: Balanced corpus supports per-class comparison; it does not estimate global prevalence.

Underlying_Risk: Committee may ask about natural observed proportions.
Original_Praxis_Problem: Natural distribution was not originally separated from the balanced evaluation.
Remediation_Action: Completed collected-source prior-shift sensitivity.
Key_Result: Observed proportions: Hijack 47.2176%, Leak 52.5835%, Outage 0.1989%; reweighted Macro F1 0.722300, weighted F1 0.916680.
Limitation: TRAIN-only prevalence-reweighted sensitivity; not global Internet prevalence.
Defense_Talking_Point: This is best named prevalence-reweighted sensitivity, not natural global distribution validation.

Underlying_Risk: Long incidents could dominate training via more windows.
Original_Praxis_Problem: Need to show why I1 was used.
Remediation_Action: Documented I1 incident-aware weighting and imbalance experiments.
Key_Result: I1 retained to equalize incident influence while retaining all windows.
Limitation: Window-count imbalance remains a design consideration; no per-incident cap was selected for final pipeline.
Defense_Talking_Point: I1 solves unequal incident influence better than raw window weighting.

Underlying_Risk: Evaluation may have leakage or unclear partition roles.

Key_Result: TRAIN 993, Validation 213, Holdout 213; Holdout sealed until Phase L.
Limitation: K1 was post-Validation TRAIN development; do not call K1 Validation-confirmed.
Defense_Talking_Point: Validation supported earlier Level-1 candidate; Final Holdout is K1's independent estimate.

Underlying_Risk: Related/duplicate incidents could cross partitions.
Original_Praxis_Problem: Existing split needed forensic evidence.
Remediation_Action: Completed partition independence audit.
Key_Result: Exact UID overlap 0 and confirmed duplicate-event pairs across partitions 0; related events documented.
Limitation: Related ASNs/prefixes/context recur naturally in BGP and are not alone leakage.

Underlying_Risk: Final model may rely on Cloudflare-labeled data only.

Limitation: External validation remains a limitation/future work; do not claim IEC performance.

Underlying_Risk: Why five minutes if live environments see updates in seconds?
Original_Praxis_Problem: Original claims risked conflating five-minute window with real-time TTI.
Remediation_Action: Completed early-horizon/TTI experiment and saturation check.
Key_Result: Performance improved through five minutes; beyond 300s gains were small/inconsistent.
Limitation: Five minutes is a practical tradeoff point, not a mathematically proven optimum.
Defense_Talking_Point: Five-minute is an analytical tradeoff, not live deployment latency.

Underlying_Risk: Time-to-identify was not originally measured.

Key_Result: Top-1 cumulative by 300s 910/983; Top-2 cumulative by 300s 965/983; 600/900 exploratory.
Limitation: TRAIN-only Level-1 retrospective analysis, not Final Holdout or live TTI.
Defense_Talking_Point: Checkpoint TTI is retrospective RouteViews-observable time, not wall-clock enterprise alerting time.
